name: Tourist Visa / Visa-Free Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of ~50 countries (including the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Japan, EU member states) may enter visa-free for up to 30 days per entry, capped at 90 days within any 180-day period, unilaterally. Citizens of Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan may enter visa-free under bilateral agreements (generally up to 90 days; Uzbekistan nationals up to 30 days). All other nationalities require a tourist visa or e-visa. Foreigners 16+ must undergo fingerprinting (dactyloscopy) when obtaining a visa or residence permit, in force since 1 January 2024. Hosts must file an arrival notification with migration authorities within 3 business days of a foreigner's arrival.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm visa-free eligibility, or apply for a tourist visa/e-visa before travel.

outcome.duration_length: up to 30 days per entry (unilateral visa-free), up to 90 days (bilateral visa-free or standard tourist visa), max 90 days per 180-day period

sources.title: WPK (Kazakhstan-focused immigration/visa consultancy) -- 2026 entry rules: ~50-country unilateral visa-free list (30 days/entry, 90 days/180-day period), bilateral visa-free agreements with CIS/regional neighbors, mandatory post-2024 fingerprinting for visa/permit applicants aged 16+, and 3-business-day host arrival-notification requirement
